# Auto-Generated Listing Videos

- Article ID: `23376210406555`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Social Studio Pro`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T02:18:47Z`
- Source: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/23376210406555-Auto-Generated-Listing-Videos

## Body

## Introduction

While all Lofty users can create up to ten (10) listing videos per day, only the advanced social studio users may make the videos without the Lofty watermark.

## Instructions

Navigate to the Listings Discovery page and select the listing. Click the arrow icon to create a social media post.

Next, the video will be created and you may select where to post, like any other social media post. Please note that if this is not your listing, you must obtain permission before posting:

#### Via the Social Studio

Navigate to the Social Studio and click "+ Create a Post".

Prompt the AI marketer to create a listing post content. Click "Add Image/Video" to select the images for the video.

Next, the video will be created and you may select where to post, like any other social media post. Please note that if this is not your listing, you must obtain permission before posting:

## Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your CRM.
